# awscc_agentregistry_publisher (Resource)

Definition of AWS::AgentRegistry::Publisher Resource Type. A Publisher is a domain that an AWS account proves ownership of. While creation is in progress, retrieve the DNS challenge through the Agent Registry ListPublishers and GetPublisher APIs. The resource reaches CREATE_COMPLETE after the domain is verified and the Publisher status is ACTIVE.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `value` (Attributes) The identifier that this Publisher proves ownership of. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--value))

### Optional

- `tags` (Attributes Set) Tags to assign to the Publisher. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the Publisher was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `publisher_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Publisher. The Publisher is a global resource, so the ARN has no Region.
- `status` (String) The verification status of the Publisher.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the Publisher was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--value"></a>
### Nested Schema for `value`

Required:

- `domain` (String) The fully qualified domain name (RFC 1035/1123) with at least two labels, in lowercase. The service stores domain names in lowercase, so specify the value in lowercase to avoid drift.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value of the tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_agentregistry_publisher.example
  identity = {
    publisher_arn = "publisher_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `publisher_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Publisher

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_agentregistry_publisher.example
  id = "publisher_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_agentregistry_publisher.example "publisher_arn"
```
